blocked_by: M2341 finds 26 redesign-related rows versus 9 coverage-materialization rows
current-sim controller comparison remains blocked until redesign-related task-quality rows are consolidated
direct training or support-policy materialization would ignore the dominant redesign blocker
supersedes: direct support-policy coverage materialization from M2340
direct controller comparison after source mapping
manual redesign-row inspection without a consolidated schema

M2342 must define output schema and decision rules before implementation
M2342 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims

do not claim residual support solved

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs consolidation schema for the dominant 26-row redesign-related task-quality blocker
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if design cannot merge M2336 redesign rows with M2340 remapped redesign candidates
stop if design routes directly to controller comparison
stop if design starts new execution or ranks support policies
stop if design claims residual support solved
fallback_plan: route to artifact-only consolidation implementation if inputs are sufficient
pivot to support coverage materialization design if redesign rows cannot be consolidated
stop for user review if the 26-row redesign blocker cannot be interpreted without new execution

admission_evidence: M2340 reports 14 scenario_or_support_redesign_candidate rows and 9 coverage-materialization rows
allowed_updates: M2342 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: the 26-row redesign-related input set is defined
the secondary 9-row coverage bucket is preserved
output schema and route decision rules are defined
a non-ranking follow-up route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2342 designs task-quality consolidation and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2342; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Redesign consolidation must be interpreted as task-quality evidence, not driver or self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: moves from coverage-gap source mapping into a consolidated redesign blocker rather than another local label tweak

must_synthesize_if: M2342 cannot define the redesign input set
the redesign consolidation branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: A design-first consolidation over the 26 redesign-related rows can define the task-quality blocker that must be addressed before current-sim controller comparison.
success_criteria: the 26-row redesign-related input set is defined
the 9-row coverage-materialization secondary bucket is preserved
output schema and decision rules are specified
a follow-up non-ranking route is selected
failure_criteria: M2342 starts training reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2342 ranks support policies or selects a winner
M2342 makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims
M2342 routes directly to controller comparison

decision_rule: M2342 passes if it defines a bounded artifact-only redesign consolidation implementation route without execution or ranking.
